content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (MFN).**

- **Responsive locations:** the first § 7.2 (p0026) imposes a disclose-and-match MFN running against us; § 12.3 (p0044) states we made no most-favoured-customer commitment, so the two conflict. No other MFN-type language exists in the document.
- **Classification:** fails fallback — the obligation is not limited to a defined product, has no 12-month sunset, and has no like-for-like comparison carve-outs; it is effectively open-ended (walk-away territory).
- **Cure (preferred level, one surgical replace):** § 7.2 now reads that "Customer has no obligation to disclose or match for Vendor any commercial offer it receives," removing the burden while leaving Vendor-granted MFN pricing in our favour untouched and creating no dangling cross-references (no clause cites Section 7.2).
- Kept boundaries clean: treated as MFN only, not double-flagged as exclusivity.
